rows.title: Python Developer for image processing for our roofing business
rows.cover_letter:

For a prior roofing‑related project I delivered a computer‑vision service that accepted image batches and returned precise bounding‑box coordinates via a Flask API [acf76910d736808e].

I will validate the prototype on a held‑out set and provide precision/recall metrics.  

**Milestone 2:** scale training to your full image library, implement post‑processing to refine placement polygons, and containerize the service for production deployment. I can start immediately and work within your $38 hourly budget. Thank you for considering my proposal; I look forward to a brief call to discuss your data sources and integration details.
